# RinVita

> Your health history. Everywhere you go. RinVita is a personal medical-records workspace that lets you upload documents in any language, uses AI to extract and translate them, and lets you share a clear summary with any clinician worldwide.

RinVita Ltd is a UK company (registered in England and Wales, number 17163153), ICO registered (ZC123014). All infrastructure is hosted in the EU (Ireland). Data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Records are processed under UK GDPR Article 9(2)(h) with explicit consent.
